# Test: public source and research library
# Machine entry point. Human protocol: START-HERE.md. Guardrails: AGENTS.md.
# Method companion: https://github.com/dwj9ddyvf6-hub/Edge (the method canon;
# this repository is the evidence it produced). Operating discipline:
# https://github.com/dwj9ddyvf6-hub/InfinityBlade-Engineering-Doctrine

## What this repository is
A public, versioned library of 654 recorded trading strategies (cards, implementation
copies, reconstruction notes), desk engineering, independent studies, educational
engines, terminal snapshots, and the November 2026 edge-hunt research record.
A committed file proves what was captured at its source revision; it does not prove
a currently running service, a live account, or a profitable strategy.

## Reading order
1. START-HERE.md: the mandatory entry protocol and evidence rules.
2. INDEX.md: the prose map of every top-level area, with counts.
3. INDEX.json: the machine-readable inventory of every file (path, blob hash, size).
4. ROADMAP.md: routing by topic.
5. The README.md or AREA.md at the top of each area you touch.
6. docs/LLM-OPERATING-GUIDE.md: worked source-to-answer workflows.

## Canonical entry points
- Strategy catalog front page: README.md (catalog only, not the whole library).
- Strategy cards: strategies/ and docs/CATALOG.json (cards only).
- Full accounting: docs/ALL-SLEEVES.json; roster snapshot: docs/SLEEVES.json.
  The three denominators differ on purpose; never merge them.
- Edge-hunt research record: research/gestalt/INDEX.md (section index), with the
  method ledger at research/gestalt/alpha-hunt-chaos/EDGE-FIND-METHOD-LEDGER.md.
- Psychology research: psychology-engine/README.md and PUBLIC_VALIDATION.md.
- Terminal snapshots: master/ and terminal-lineup/ (publisher-owned; dated data,
  not live health).

## Status vocabulary (what is proven, prospective, dead)
- PROVEN: graded on a final artifact or a resolved sample, with the receipt named.
- PROSPECTIVE: registered with a falsifier and accruing forward; not yet decided.
  The overnight Focus-names edge and RND-7 are prospective: their backtests are
  stated with trial counts in research/gestalt/, and their 60-session forward
  falsifiers from 16 November 2026 will decide them.
- DEAD: killed by its own registered falsifier on its own resolved sample, or
  rejected at its exam. Dead objects stay in the library as evidence.
- A historical status word such as "live" inside a snapshot keeps its captured
  context; it is not a claim about today.

## Standing cautions
- Never quote a result without its trial count and its limiting numbers.
- Search INDEX.json by path fragment before concluding any file is absent.
- Historical packages are not automatically the current implementation.
- This library authorizes nothing: no account, order, deployment or schedule.
- No personal identifiers appear in this repository; do not add any.
